title: Challenger Principles Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners reveal the three Challenger principles (teach, tailor, take control) with examples, see how they work together, and answer three scenario questions with one attempt each.

learningObjectives: Explain how the three Challenger principles (teach, tailor, take control) work together to drive customer action.
prerequisites: Challenger Sales Methodology, Teaching Principle, Tailoring Principle, and Taking Control Principle sections of Chapter 1

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Guided exploration followed by a quiz
keyQuestions: Explain how the three Challenger principles (teach, tailor, take control) work together to drive customer action.
commonMisconceptions: The principles are sequential steps rather than integrated behaviors.
Teaching means lecturing rather than sharing insights.
Taking control means being pushy rather than providing structure.
assessmentOpportunities: 3 of 3 quiz questions correct on the first attempt.
Learner can explain why the principles are integrated behaviors rather than steps.
